climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Columbia Valley AVA on plateaus overlooking the Columbia River in Franklin County, Washington, about 10 miles north of the Tri-Cities. It began with nine vineyards on about 1,127 acres and one winery.
